blocks.text:
Swipe between Home pages and each one leans a little as it passes, turning through its middle and stepping back slightly. It's the calmest of the page effects: labels stay easy to read all the way through a swipe.

Install it, then choose it in Settings › Gestures › Page Effects. Pages slide flat while you move an app or resize a widget, and Reduce Motion turns every page effect off. Removing the package puts back the built-in effect you had.

Inspired by Barrel by Aaron Ash. Re-created from scratch for Folio; no tweak code is included.

items: Pages turn 18° at a full page out
Pages step back to 92% of their size
Turns through the middle of the page

entries.notes: Tilt arrives in the Folio Market. Needs Folio 0.6.8.
